texto_aprovado: Keep two things in mind about that ranking. Researchers have since criticized mouse tests like that one, partly because they don't reflect what happens when a snake bites a person. And a ranking of venoms, drop for drop, says nothing about how often a snake and a person meet. This snake is, in the words of a South Australian government fact sheet, "usually quite shy."
